ai.receipt.show.tip: Select and frame the changed elements
ai.receipt.rollback.tip: Return the model to how it was before this apply: later changes are taken back too, Ctrl+Y brings them back
ai.receipt.toast_rolled: Rolled back {n} steps to before the applied plan
ai.receipt.rollback_failed: Cannot roll back: a later step is not on the undo stack, nothing was changed
ai.receipt.promote.tip: Turn the draft family into a working one (one undo step)
ai.receipt.promote_failed: The family could not be made working
